reviews.scopeMarkdown:
Bài gốc: **231 từ**, đếm trên nguyên văn bằng cách tách theo khoảng trắng; đủ tối thiểu 150 từ của đề nhưng vượt 31 từ so với giới hạn 200 từ của lớp.
Phạm vi: chỉ chấm bài Đề 1 đã gõ; chưa chấm Đề 2 hoặc bản scan.
reviews.overall: Bài này em cần sửa và nộp lại. Bài có 231 từ nhưng Overview vẫn thiếu thông tin Italy đứng đầu cuối kỳ. Đoạn cuối gọi tám năm 2004–2012 là “latter half”, đồng thời rút diễn biến của France thành một mức giảm không đáng kể nên chưa phản ánh rõ nhịp giảm rồi phục hồi. Em đã vận dụng đúng “with a subsequent…” và “the figure for…”, nhưng cần kiểm tra đơn vị của các mức chênh lệch. Đây là kiến thức em đã ghi chép và Cô đã giảng kỹ; em phải dùng lại để tự sửa các câu được đánh dấu trước khi nộp lại.
reviews.dataGrouping: Em chia theo thời gian: Detail 1 trình bày năm nước từ 2000 đến 2004; Detail 2 tiếp tục từ 2004 đến 2012. Cách chia này có cơ sở vì năm 2004 là mốc France đạt đỉnh, nên Cô giữ hai nhóm thời gian và thứ tự nước em đang trình bày. Em cần gọi đúng hai khoảng không bằng nhau, bổ sung mức đầu/cuối còn thiếu và làm rõ diễn biến France cùng sự ổn định tương đối của Belgium sau 2004 (C03, C05–C06).

The given line chart illustrates the proportion of female parliamentarians in five European countries, namely Germany, Italy, France, the UK, and Belgium, over a 12-year period from 2000 to 2012.
    Overall, there was a general increase in the share of women in parliament in all five countries. Also of note is that the figure for the UK increased sharply from 2000 to 2012, despite remaining the lowest for most of the period.
     To elaborate, in 2000, the proportion of women in parliament in Germany stood at 34%, with a subsequent insignificant rise to around 34.5% in 2004. Meanwhile, the figure for France increased sharply from around 25% to 37% from 2000 to 2004, marking the highest figure during the former half of the studied period. Similarly, the data for the UK, Italy, and Belgium went up by roughly 4%, 5%, and 11% respectively over the first 4-year period.
      Regarding the latter half of the provided timeline, the percentage of female parliamentarians in the UK continued to increase strongly from 8% to 28% throughout an 8-year period. Despite this, the figure for the UK remained the lowest for most of the chart. In contrast, the data for France insignificantly declined by around 5% over these 8 years. Meanwhile, the share of female parliamentarians in Belgium, Germany, and Italy increased by roughly 0.5%, 1.5%, and 8% respectively during the remainder of the period.

Mức khoảng 33% trong bản gợi ý theo hình; sai lệch nhỏ với 34% em đọc không phải trọng tâm cần phê bình.

The given line chart illustrates how female representation in parliament, expressed as a percentage, changed in five European countries between 2000 and 2012.

Overall, the proportion of female parliamentarians increased in all five countries, most markedly in the United Kingdom. Italy finished with the highest figure, while the United Kingdom generally had the lowest, sharing this position with Belgium in 2012.

To elaborate, in 2000, about 33% of parliamentarians in Germany were women, with a subsequent slight rise to 34.5% in 2004. The figure for France rose more sharply from 25% to a leading 37%. Those for the United Kingdom, Italy and Belgium also climbed from 3%, 26% and 17% to 8%, 31% and 28%, respectively.

From 2004 onwards, the percentage of female parliamentarians in the United Kingdom rose to 28% in 2012, matching that for Belgium, which remained broadly stable. In contrast, the figure for France fell sharply before recovering to around 31%. Meanwhile, those for Germany and Italy increased to approximately 37% and 39%, respectively.

The given two pie charts illustrate the primary factors influencing students’ choice of a particular university in the UK, spanning a 10-year timeframe from 1997 to 2007.
   Overall, suitable degree courses remained the most dominant factor influencing students’ choice of university in both years. Also of note is that the reason for proximity to parental home sharply increased over 10 years, while the opposite was true for good sports and social activities, marking the lowest figure in 2007.
    To elaborate, the proportion of students choosing suitable degree courses insignificantly increased by 2 percentage points over a decade, marking the top choice of students throughout the period of time. In addition, the figures for proximity to parental home and quality of teaching witnessed signs of growth from 10% and 15% to 22% and 18%, respectively.
     Regarding the factors that witnessed a decline, the share of students choosing quality of resources slightly went down by 4 percentage points between 1997 and 2007. Similarly, the proportion of good sports and social activities dramatically decreased from 19% to 6% over the same period of time, marking the lowest figure of the entire pie chart in 2007.

Ở Introduction, “illustrate the primary factors influencing students’ choice…” diễn đạt đúng ý đề. Em có thể luyện thêm cách “illustrate how students’ main reasons for choosing a particular university … differed between 1997 and 2007”. Mệnh đề “how + S + V” diễn đạt sự khác nhau giữa các lý do ở hai năm; “influencing students’ choice” trong câu gốc đã là cách rút gọn đúng, tương ứng với “which influenced students’ choice”.

By contrast, New Zealand registered the lowest numbers overall, with only 6 top-ranked universities in Biology, 4 in Psychology, and a mere 2 in Medicine.
